glosses: Having length; long and overextended, especially in time rather than dimension.

examples.text: a lengthy discussion

a lengthy text

examples.text: If, in addition to being a lengthy preacher, he had also been a Rev. Mr. Mumbles or a Rev. Dr. Drone, the penance thus endured by his people would have been intolerably severe.

glosses: Existing or occurring without interruption or end; ceaseless, unending.

examples.text: Life's interminable succession of stages.

an endless line

glosses: Too much or many to be exhausted; an extremely high number or amount of; immeasurable, innumerable.

examples.text: In 1903, [Albert Shhoenhut] announced his Humpty Dumpty circus, with over 20 figures and animals, each with six joints enabling them to be put into endless positions.
